run_descriptor_test: run the unittest suite for google.protobuf.internal.descriptor to verify descriptor behavior
test_enum_value_name: test the MessageDescriptor.EnumValueName method to look up enum value names by number
test_get_options: test the GetOptions method on descriptors to retrieve custom protobuf options
test_copy_to_proto: test the CopyToProto method to serialize descriptor data into DescriptorProto messages
test_make_descriptor: test the MakeDescriptor function to create descriptors from DescriptorProto definitions
